{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE DataKinds #-}
{-# LANGUAGE TypeOperators #-}

module NotificationService where

import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BC
import Data.IORef
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Control.Monad (when, unless)
import Data.Char (ord, chr)
import Data.Word (Word8)

-- Role-based access control
data Role = Admin | Manager | User | Guest deriving (Eq, Ord, Show)

data Session = Session
  { sessionUser  :: Text
  , sessionRole  :: Role
  , sessionEmail :: Text
  } deriving (Show)

data NotifyRequest = NotifyRequest
  { nrRecipient   :: Text
  , nrSubject     :: Text
  , nrBody        :: Text
  , nrReplyTo     :: Maybe Text
  , nrPriority    :: Maybe Text
  } deriving (Show)

data EmailHeader = EmailHeader
  { ehName  :: ByteString
  , ehValue :: ByteString
  } deriving (Show)

data EmailMessage = EmailMessage
  { emHeaders :: [EmailHeader]
  , emBody    :: ByteString
  } deriving (Show)

-- RBAC check: only Admin and Manager can send notifications
canSendNotification :: Role -> Bool
canSendNotification Admin   = True
canSendNotification Manager = True
canSendNotification _       = False

-- Encoding helper: encode display name for email header
encodeDisplayName :: Text -> ByteString
encodeDisplayName name =
  let bs = TE.encodeUtf8 name
  in if BS.any needsQuoting bs
     then BC.concat ["\"", bs, "\""]
     else bs
  where
    needsQuoting w = w `elem` map (fromIntegral . ord) "@<>()[]\\,;:"

-- Sanitize a header value by removing CR/LF sequences
-- This prevents header injection via newline characters
sanitizeHeaderValue :: ByteString -> ByteString
sanitizeHeaderValue = BC.filter (\c -> c /= '\r' && c /= '\n')

-- Normalize unicode text: fold certain homoglyphs
-- This handles the case where attackers use unicode lookalikes
normalizeText :: Text -> Text
normalizeText = T.map normalizeChar
  where
    normalizeChar '\x2028' = ' '  -- Line Separator -> space
    normalizeChar '\x2029' = ' '  -- Paragraph Separator -> space  
    normalizeChar '\x0085' = ' '  -- Next Line -> space
    normalizeChar c = c

-- Validate email format (simplified)
validateEmail :: Text -> Bool
validateEmail email =
  T.any (== '@') email &&
  not (T.null (T.takeWhile (/= '@') email)) &&
  not (T.null (T.drop 1 (T.dropWhile (/= '@') email)))

-- Build the RFC 2047 encoded-word if needed
encodeRFC2047 :: Text -> ByteString
encodeRFC2047 txt =
  let bs = TE.encodeUtf8 txt
  in if BS.all (\w -> w >= 0x20 && w <= 0x7E) bs
     then bs
     else BC.concat ["=?UTF-8?B?", base64Encode bs, "?="]

-- Simplified base64 (placeholder)
base64Encode :: ByteString -> ByteString
base64Encode = id  -- In production, use real base64

-- Safe folding: uses spaces only, no CRLF injection possible
-- Truncates rather than folds to avoid any injection vector
safeTruncateHeader :: ByteString -> ByteString
safeTruncateHeader val
  | BC.length val <= 998 = val  -- RFC 5322 max line length
  | otherwise = BC.take 998 val

-- Build email message from request
buildEmail :: Session -> NotifyRequest -> Either Text EmailMessage
buildEmail session req = do
  unless (canSendNotification (sessionRole session)) $
    Left "Access denied: insufficient role"
  unless (validateEmail (nrRecipient req)) $
    Left "Invalid recipient email"
  
  let normalizedSubject = normalizeText (nrSubject req)
      sanitizedSubject  = sanitizeHeaderValue (TE.encodeUtf8 normalizedSubject)
      
      fromAddr = TE.encodeUtf8 (sessionEmail session)
      toAddr   = sanitizeHeaderValue (TE.encodeUtf8 (nrRecipient req))
      
      -- Build base headers
      baseHeaders = 
        [ EmailHeader "From" fromAddr
        , EmailHeader "To" toAddr
        , EmailHeader "Subject" (safeTruncateHeader sanitizedSubject)
        , EmailHeader "MIME-Version" "1.0"
        , EmailHeader "Content-Type" "text/plain; charset=utf-8"
        ]
      
      -- Optional Reply-To header
      replyToHeader = case nrReplyTo req of
            Nothing -> []
            Just rt -> 
              let normalized = normalizeText rt
                  encoded = encodeDisplayName normalized
                  sanitized = sanitizeHeaderValue encoded
                  -- Safe: truncate instead of fold
                  truncated = safeTruncateHeader sanitized
              in [EmailHeader "Reply-To" truncated]
      
      -- Optional priority header  
      priorityHeader = case nrPriority req of
            Nothing -> []
            Just p  -> 
              let sanitized = sanitizeHeaderValue (TE.encodeUtf8 p)
              in [EmailHeader "X-Priority" sanitized]
      
      allHeaders = baseHeaders ++ replyToHeader ++ priorityHeader
      body = sanitizeHeaderValue (TE.encodeUtf8 (nrBody req))
  
  Right $ EmailMessage allHeaders body

-- Serialize email to wire format
serializeEmail :: EmailMessage -> ByteString
serializeEmail msg =
  let headerLines = map (\h -> BC.concat [ehName h, ": ", ehValue h]) (emHeaders msg)
      headerBlock = BC.intercalate "\r\n" headerLines
  in BC.concat [headerBlock, "\r\n\r\n", emBody msg]

-- gRPC handler simulation
handleNotifyRPC :: IORef (Map Text Session) -> Text -> NotifyRequest -> IO (Either Text ByteString)
handleNotifyRPC sessionsRef token req = do
  sessions <- readIORef sessionsRef
  case Map.lookup token sessions of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Authentication required"
    Just session -> do
      case buildEmail session req of
        Left err -> return $ Left err
        Right email -> do
          let serialized = serializeEmail email
          -- In production: send via SMTP
          return $ Right serialized
